name: Troll Monarch — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Troll Monarch from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's pages "Troll Monarch (CR 15)", "Troll Monarch" but are not part of the Troll Monarch entry, which is unchanged.

From d20pfsrd.com: Troll Monarch (CR 15)

TROLL MONARCH
CR 15

Only the mightiest of trolls hope to become kings or queens among their kind. Becoming a monarch requires a combination of luck, skill, brute strength, intelligence (at least compared to other trolls), and perhaps a helpful magic item to give an advantage compared to others.

XP 51,200
Troll fighter 10
CE Large humanoid (giant)
